name: The Sophomore
source:
A continuation of The Freshman, following the MC from that series as she enters her second year of college, facing yet more trials and tribulations in her life. 

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Sophomore]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
本作延续《The Freshman》的故事，讲述该系列女主人公升入大学二年级后，在生活中面临的更多考验与磨难。

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Category:The_Sophomore]Choices Wikia[/url]]
